title: The Pokémon League Gauntlet
party_selection_rule: 6 vs 6 Full Party Battle (standard Pokémon League rules; all 6 party members battle)
overview: The Indigo Plateau gauntlet is the ultimate test of Act 1: five consecutive high-tier trainer battles with no mid-gauntlet Pokémon Center visits. Lorelei leads with Ice/Water bulks, Bruno commands Fighting/Steel brawn, Agatha exploits Ghost/Poison status hexes, Lance unleashes high-speed Dragons, and Champion Blue tests your mastery with a diverse 6-mon roster headlined by Mythical Mew (Lv. 62) wielding Hydro Cannon and Flare Blitz.

elite_four_summary.key_threats: Weavile/Lapras (Lv. 57 Dark/Ice), Jynx/Tangrowth (Lv. 57 Ice/Grass), Magmar/Dewgong (Lv. 54 Fire/Ice). Exploit Rock, Fighting, and Electric moves; avoid Sleep and Hail chip.
Magnezone/Onix (Lv. 57 Electric/Ground), Scizor/Heracross (Lv. 57 Bug/Fighting), Steelix/Machamp (Lv. 53 Steel/Fighting). Ground shreds Magnezone; Fire melts Scizor; Psychic wipes Fighting types.
Snorlax/Gengar (Lv. 58 Normal/Ghost), Mismagius/Crobat (Lv. 57 Ghost/Poison), Wobbuffet/Gengar (Lv. 55 Destiny Bond/Counter). Beware Destiny Bond/Counter; strike with Dark or special bursts.
Tyranitar/Aerodactyl (Lv. 59 Rock/Flying), Togekiss/Dragonite (Lv. 58 Fairy/Flying), Dragonair/Gyarados (Lv. 55 Rain Dance). Ice Beam and Thunderbolt decimate his dual Flying/Dragon team.

roster.tactics: Blazing fast special lead. Sets Reflect and boosts defenses. Strike immediately with Electric, Grass, Ghost, Dark, or Bug moves before screens go up.
Heavy wallbreaker. Suffers 4x Bug weakness (U-turn / X-Scissor) or 2x Fire, Ice, Flying, Poison, and Fighting. Punish the recharge turn after Giga Impact.
Swords Dance booster with ground/flying coverage. Flying grants Ground immunity. Ice, Psychic, Electric, and Rock moves quickly take it down.
Heavy mixed tank. Spreads burn with Will-O-Wisp. Suffers a fatal 4x weakness to Water and 2x to Ground. Cleanly OHKO with Surf or Waterfall.
Fierce Dragon Dancer. Electric/Flying grants Ground immunity; weak only to Rock and Ice. Hit hard with Stone Edge or Ice Beam before boosts stack.
Champion Blue's Mythical Ace. High all-around stats with Hydro Cannon and Flare Blitz. Exploit recharge and recoil turns with Dark, Ghost, and Bug STAB strikes.

starter_strategies.bulbasaur: Venusaur/Charizard uses Solar Beam/Petal Dance against Lorelei and Blue's Rhydon/Magmortar while resisting Bruno's Fighting moves. Alakazam/Weezing provides Levitate Ground immunity and Psychic STAB against Bruno and Agatha. Gyarados/Arbok intimidates and fires Ice Fang at Lance's dragons. Snorlax sponges Mew's bursts.
starter_strategies.charmander: Charizard/Venusaur provides Ground immunity and dual Grass/Fire STAB, melting Lorelei's Ice types and destroying Blue's Tauros and Rhydon. Lapras carries Ice Beam and Surf to dismantle Lance's Flying/Dragon squad. Gyarados/Nidoking pivots with Intimidate. Snorlax walls Mew with colossal HP and Body Slam.
starter_strategies.squirtle: Blastoise/Fearow provides Ground immunity and crushes Bruno and Blue's Fire/Ground threats with Hydro Pump. Alakazam/Weezing dominates Bruno with Psychic and pivots on Earthquakes. Jolteon/Sandslash outspeeds and electrocutes Lorelei's Water types and Blue's Gyarados fusion. Snorlax walls Agatha's Ghost strikes.
